correctness.rationale: For the 12 ordered-pair vertices (i,j), adjacent when same first coordinate or reverse, there are exactly 18 edges and 72 independent triples. Independently generated all 3674 total-three-cut faces via complements of independent triples; face dimensions -1 through 8 match (1,12,66,220,495,792,918,744,354,72). A lexicographic vertex-toggling matching pairs 1834 augmented faces and leaves precisely six dimension-six cells; directed Hasse check has 3673 ordinary nodes and 20928 ordinary cover arrows, is acyclic. Removing the empty pair gives a critical vertex and six 6-cells, so the integral homotopy is wedge^6 S6. Independent signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz enumeration over S4 yields traces by cycle type (6,-2,2,0,0); this is sign tensor the six K4-edge permutation module, with no trivial constituent. Since pure facet dimension 8 but H6 nonzero, it is nonshellable. Only rational character, no equivariant homotopy asserted.

originality.rationale: PASS: total k-cut (complements of INDEPENDENT triples) is not ordinary cut (complements of disconnected triples). The published 2024–25 general total-cut results treat chordal, cyclic, bipartite, prism and grids, none containing this specific nonchordal tetrahedral truncation with S4 rational homology character. An earlier ordinary cut theorem for the same graph gives a different complex and rank. No covering total-three-cut statement was identified.
